metas.name: 1 · ★ 6.1 · 1993 · Free Willy
metas.description: When a boy learns that a beloved killer whale is to be killed by the aquarium owners, the boy risks everything to free the whale.

metas.name: 2 · ★ 5.1 · 1995 · Free Willy 2: The Adventure Home
metas.description: Teenager Jesse becomes reunited with Willy two years after the whale's jump to freedom as the teenager tries to rescue the killer whale and other orcas from an oil spill.

metas.name: 3 · ★ 4.8 · 1997 · Free Willy 3: The Rescue
metas.description: 16-year-old Jesse and old friend Randolph try to foil an illegal whaler threatening Willy and his pregnant mate.
